goal: Build and verify the Spine backend (TS/Fastify/Postgres) and wire the four Stitch screens into React/Vite, closing every loop with machine-run checks.
no_touch: packages/db/schema.sql is the single source of schema truth

tasks.title: Shared core: ingress, provenance, confidence policy, review queue, supersession, run traces
tasks.done_when: The unit and pipeline suites pass, including provenance-not-null, supersession, idempotency, dedup and confidence-policy invariants.

tasks.title: Deterministic/LLM boundary is provable, not merely documented
tasks.done_when: No module under core/ imports the AI layer; no date arithmetic lives outside core/.

tasks.title: Language rule enforced in generated output and in UI copy
tasks.done_when: No forbidden phrasing appears in any generated string persisted to the database, nor anywhere in the frontend copy.

tasks.title: Seed is reproducible from scratch and produces the engineered Okafor demo
tasks.done_when: A clean reset yields 8 matters, the 94-day item with 3 follow-ups, a partially received item, the three diff observations and one unmatched file. Seeding is pinned to fixture mode so stage data is reproducible.

tasks.title: Frontend builds and the four screens are wired to the API
tasks.done_when: vite build succeeds and typecheck is clean.

tasks.title: End-to-end: a running API answers every surface the demo needs
tasks.done_when: The API smoke script passes against a live server, including the live Simulate Ava pipeline.
